name: Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles
tagline: AnchorFix® resin mixing and application accessory
summary: Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles are fixed onto each AnchorFix® product to achieve the correct mixing of the 2-part cartridge anchoring adhesive and application into drilled anchoring holes.
metaDescription: Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles are fixed onto each AnchorFix® product to achieve the correct mixing of the 2-part cartridge anchoring adhesive and application into drilled anchoring holes.

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: All Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
The following system products must be used:
Sika AnchorFix® 1 anchoring adhesive
Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Once used Sika AnchorFix® Static Mixers / Nozzles cannot be cleaned
